facts.en: Completed a production administration diploma at Fictional Oakhollow College in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构橡谷学院完成生产行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid workshop office assistant at Fictional Thimblewood Joinery from 2020-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2020-04 至 2026-08 在虚构顶针木细木工坊任有薪工坊办公室助理。

facts.en: Updated the job board from the foreman’s approved build sequence and recorded expected collection dates.
facts.zh: 依据工头批准的制作顺序更新工单板，并记录预计取件日期。

facts.en: Checked material deliveries against purchase orders and noted short quantities or visible damage.
facts.zh: 按采购订单核对材料到货，并记录数量短缺或可见损坏。

facts.en: Reserved boards and fittings against job references after the foreman confirmed the material specification.
facts.zh: 在工头确认材料规格后，按工单编号预留木板及五金配件。

facts.en: Prepared supplier follow-up lists for missing fittings and revised arrival estimates.
facts.zh: 为缺失五金配件及修订到货预期准备供应商跟进清单。

facts.en: Informed customers of revised collection windows using dates approved by the foreman.
facts.zh: 使用工头批准的日期，通知客户修订后的取件窗口。

facts.en: Created a linked job-and-materials worksheet in 2024-08 with the workshop purchaser.
facts.zh: 2024-08 与工坊采购员共同制作关联工单与材料的工作表。

facts.en: Personally built the job-reference and expected-arrival columns; the purchaser supplied order values.
facts.zh: 个人建立工单编号及预计到货列；订单金额由采购员提供。

facts.en: During a 2024-09 check, 27 of 29 sampled open jobs had a linked purchase-order reference in the worksheet.
facts.zh: 2024-09 检查中，29 份抽样未完结工单有 27 份在工作表中关联采购订单编号。

facts.en: Kept drawing revisions attached to the corresponding job packet and marked superseded copies.
facts.zh: 将图纸修订版附于相应工单资料包，并标记已被替代的副本。

facts.en: The foreman approved cutting dimensions and workshop methods; the candidate did not operate production cutting machinery.
facts.zh: 工头批准切割尺寸及工坊加工方法；候选人不操作生产切割机械。

facts.en: Uses shared production calendars, spreadsheet lookups and supplier order portals.
facts.zh: 使用共享生产日历、电子表格查找及供应商订单门户。

facts.en: Prepared an end-of-day handover listing delayed materials, customer callbacks and jobs awaiting revised drawings.
facts.zh: 准备每日结束交接清单，列出延误材料、客户回电及等待修订图纸的工单。

facts.en: Completed an internal drawing-revision orientation in 2021; it did not confer a carpentry trade qualification.
facts.zh: 2021 年完成内部图纸版本入门培训；该培训不授予木工行业资格。

facts.en: Made a personal cardboard model of a bookshelf in 2022, separate from customer fabrication work.
facts.zh: 2022 年制作个人书架纸板模型，与客户加工工作分开。

facts.en: Volunteered to organize donated screws and drawer handles at Fictional Hazelpatch Repair Day in 2023-06.
facts.zh: 2023-06 在虚构榛补修理日活动中志愿整理捐赠螺丝及抽屉拉手。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing small furniture arrangements for imaginary rooms.
facts.zh: 爱好为想象中的房间绘制小型家具布局。

facts.en: Maintained collection receipts after customers signed for completed items.
facts.zh: 在客户签收已完成物品后维护取件收据。
